text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — a passionate, hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building responsive web applications.

I’d be excited to help you build your website and mobile app from the ground up and integrate the AI tools your project needs. I have strong experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and building clean user experiences with HTML, CSS, and Tailwind CSS.

In a staff onboarding portal for healthcare staffing, I built a system where nurses uploaded credentials and managers approved them by region, helping reduce onboarding paperwork from 5 days to 1 day. I also built a live fleet dashboard that showed truck locations and ETAs in real time, tracking 1,800 trucks with under 2 seconds from ping to screen.

I’d love to discuss your AI image generation flow and the additional integrations you need.
